tasks.title: HOTFIX: Restore backward-compatible non-generative-UI mode via feature flag
tasks.last_error: Review approved: Implementation correctly restores backward-compatible non-generative-UI mode via feature flag. Config flag chat.generative_ui.enabled defaults to false. Both ChatQueryService::injectSystemPrompt() and FinalAnswerTool properly condition behavior on flag. Tests cover both enabled/disabled states. Lint clean.
tasks.summary: Commit 71c421e added 'Internal links are rendered by the generative UI' to ChatQueryService.php:1127 (response_structure instruction) and FinalAnswerTool.php:69 (links description) without implementing a frontend renderer in chat.blade.php. This broke backward compatibility: the LLM promises an interactive UI the client cannot render, degrading to text-only. Fix: introduce config flag chat.generative_ui.enabled (default false). When false, injectSystemPrompt() and FinalAnswerTool use the legacy text-only instruction (no generative-UI promise). When true, use the current generative-UI instruction. Add PromptBuilder/FinalAnswerTool tests covering both flag states. Scope: /home/hamid/sima-dev (branch bugfix/post-release-2.0.0).

tasks.summary: The backend RenderDynamicUiTool returns {component,title,fields,data,action} via tool_execution_end, and FinalAnswerTool returns links with internal:true, but chat.blade.php readChatStream only handles `candidates` and `screen_candidate` tools — render_dynamic_ui and internal links are silently dropped. Implement a client-side renderer: (1) handle tool_execution_end for render_dynamic_ui by rendering the widget (table/card/form/chart) from the payload; (2) render internal links from final_answer.links as in-app navigation (pushState) instead of dropping them. Gate behind the same chat.generative_ui.enabled flag so the text-only fallback remains default. Scope: /home/hamid/sima-dev (branch bugfix/post-release-2.0.0).
